goalZh: 会描述一个人的外貌:高矮、头发、戴不戴眼镜
canDoZh: 能用几句话描述一个人的长相,让没见过他的人也能认出来

newItems.noteZh: 问长相用 look like;问性格用 What's he like?(下一课),两句很容易混。问对方:What do you look like?
美国口语里说“那个男生”常说 that guy;复数 guys 也可以泛指一群人。
说人高用 tall,不用 high;词尾 l 舌尖要抬起来。
可以说人矮,也可以说头发短:short hair。说自己矮,口语里更委婉的说法是 I'm not very tall.。
头发是不可数名词:She has long hair.(不说 hairs,也不加 a)。
词尾 ng 是后鼻音 /ŋ/,不要读成“long-g”。
bl 之间不要加元音;a 读 /æ/。
中国人说的“黑眼睛”,英语一般说 brown eyes;“黄头发”多说 blond hair。
眼镜永远用复数 glasses,词尾读 /ɪz/;“他戴眼镜”可以说 He has glasses.,也常说 wear glasses(wear 第 6 单元学)。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Hi, Sofia! Your older brother... what does he look like?
lines.zh: 嗨,索菲亚!你哥哥……他长什么样?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: He's a big guy. He's tall, and he has short black hair.
lines.zh: 他块头挺大,个子很高,黑色短发。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Sorry? Could you say that again?
lines.zh: 不好意思?你能再说一遍吗?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Tall, short black hair, and glasses. And you? What do you look like?
lines.zh: 高个子,黑色短发,戴眼镜。那你呢?你长什么样?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I have short black hair, and I'm not very tall.
lines.zh: 我是黑色短发,个子不太高。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Sofia, it's Lei. There are two tall guys here.
lines.zh: 索菲亚,是我,磊。这儿有两个高个子男生。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Two tall guys? What do they look like?
lines.zh: 两个高个子?他们长什么样?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: One guy has long brown hair, and one guy has glasses.
lines.zh: 一个是棕色长发,一个戴眼镜。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: The guy with glasses! That's my brother. Thank you, Lei!
lines.zh: 戴眼镜的那个!那就是我哥哥。谢谢你,磊!

options: 个子高,棕色长发,戴眼镜
个子高,黑色短发,戴眼镜
questions.explainZh: 索菲亚说 He's tall, and he has short black hair.;磊没听清,她重复时又补了一句 and glasses(还戴眼镜)。
两个男生个子都很高:一个是棕色长发,一个戴眼镜。索菲亚说 The guy with glasses! That's my brother.

grammar.titleZh: 描述长相:be + 形容词,have / has + 名词
grammar.bodyZh: 说高矮用 be:He's tall. I'm not very tall.;说头发、眼镜这些“长在身上、戴在身上的”用 have / has:He has short black hair. He has glasses.。中文说“他黑头发”,英语要说 He has black hair,不能说 He is black hair。几个形容词放在名词前,先说长短、再说颜色:short black hair、long brown hair。hair 是不可数名词,不加 -s,也不加 a。问长相用 What does he look like?,问对方用 What do you look like?。发音:hair 结尾要卷舌;tall、long 里的 l 舌尖要顶住上齿龈。

examples.text: He's tall, and he has short black hair.
What does she look like? — She has long brown hair.
examples.zh: 她长什么样?——她是棕色长发。
